items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: How about Rapolo? Do you know Rapolo? Sure. Uh huh. I think he's probably studied with his father I think.

ctx.x: Ah, the boss. They all come under these. How about Rapolo? Do you know Rapolo? Sure. Uh huh. I think he's probably studied with his father I think. Yeah. Yeah.

Now do you think it's possible to learn the clarinet just by yourself even without learning to read music? Like some people just pick it up. Sidney Bechet never did learn to read music so well I don't believe did he?
